title: Claude doubles rate limits #claude #ratelimits #anthropic
description:
Claude doubled rate limits for paid users after Anthropic secured massive new compute through a SpaceX deal tied to the Colossus One data center. The expansion includes more than 300 megawatts of power and 220,000 Nvidia GPUs coming online this month.

That scale is enough to materially change how Claude performs for both consumers and developers. Pro and Max users now get roughly double the usage in a five-hour window, with peak-hour slowdowns removed, while Claude Opus API limits are also rising for builders.

The broader shift is clear: frontier AI products are increasingly constrained by infrastructure, not just model quality. Anthropic’s access to hyperscale GPU capacity turns raw compute into a direct product advantage, improving reliability, throughput, and developer utility at a time when demand for advanced AI assistants keeps climbing.
